BL-1044 — A glance at six terminal windows says which role each is, never which ticket it holds: put the ticket in the tmux window name so it reaches the OS title bar
What it solves: ## Facts confirmed live while scoping
Approval context: Your ask, from the six-window screenshot: put the ticket in the terminal title, number without the `BL-` prefix plus a small slug, and show the last cleared ticket when idle. Kept deliberately small.

ONE FINDING THAT SHAPED IT. The obvious place - the pane title - is already taken. The `"* Handoff…
BL-1044 needs your approval before it can proceed. Reply here with "approve BL-1044" (or "reject BL-1044 <reason>") to act.
